desc: Implement input reading for N and string s.
Create a function to generate all cycle orientations and their in-degrees for small N to verify logic.
Develop a DP approach to count distinct in-degree sequences considering the hub edges.
Handle the modulo arithmetic for the final count.
Implement a DP or combinatorial formula for large N.
Optimize the solution to run in O(N) or O(N log N) time.
